$comment: Content plan for a club whose ScorePlay library is NOT a full match. Each format is a different kind of club footage. Video formats: a real TwelveLabs search over the club's own index (club-<key>), scoped to one ScorePlay collection. Photo formats: picked from the club photographer's captions (names never come from ScorePlay player tags, which were wrong on real photos). Built from what ScorePlay holds for San Antonio (probed 2026-10-23): Raw Footage (32 camera clips), Social Edits (36 finished posts incl. postgame interviews), Photos (187 stills incl. in-game partner activations).
